result.summary: Analysis identifies two minor issues related to content display and visual asset consistency.

issues.description: Restaurant names in the horizontal carousel are truncated, obscuring the full merchant title.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card width or allow for two-line text wrapping to maintain readability.

issues.description: Generic vector illustrations are used instead of real food photography, reducing perceived app quality.
issues.suggestion: Implement high-resolution food images to improve visual appeal and user confidence.
